name: charge parity symmetry

phase_0.boundary_condition: The Hamiltonian operator defining the closed boundary of the Hilbert space and enforcing unitary evolution.

VINIT.justification: The baseline state with zero net charge, chirality, and spatial extension before any excitations.

TANCH.justification: The closed boundary operator that restricts the system to physically realizable eigenstates.

AFWD.justification: The unitary propagation of the positive frequency particle state.

AREV.justification: The contravariant transformation mapping particles to antiparticles with inverted spatial coordinates.

CLINK.justification: The chaining of the C and P morphisms into a single combined transformation.

IMSCRIB.justification: The self referential mathematical structure that remains unchanged under its own transformations.

FSPLIT.justification: The separation of a neutral eigenstate into distinct particle and antiparticle branches.

FFUSE.justification: The superposition of particle and antiparticle branches recovering the original neutral state.

EVALT.justification: The affirmative branch where strong and electromagnetic interactions preserve the symmetry.

EVALF.justification: The negative branch where weak interactions introduce asymmetric phase shifts.

ENGAGR.justification: The simultaneous holding of CP even and CP odd components in a physical mass eigenstate.

IFIX.justification: The permanent recording of the complex mixing matrix elements that explicitly break the symmetry.

phase_3.void_description: Perfectly symmetric vacuum with zero charge conjugation eigenvalue and undefined parity.
phase_3.true_description: Pure CP even eigenstate exhibiting exact symmetry under combined charge and spatial inversion.
phase_3.false_description: Pure CP odd eigenstate acquiring a negative sign under the combined transformation.
phase_3.both_description: Physical mass eigenstate exhibiting simultaneous CP even and CP odd characteristics due to weak interaction mixing.

steps.domain_action: Establish the unperturbed quantum vacuum as the initial uncharged scalar field.
Apply the Hamiltonian operator to bound the Hilbert space and define admissible eigenstates.
Evolve the initial neutral particle excitation forward in time via the unitary propagator.
Bifurcate the neutral state into the particle branch and the antiparticle branch.
Verify the T arm where the strong interaction Hamiltonian conserves charge parity.
Apply spatial inversion and charge reversal to the F arm generating the conjugate antiparticle state.
Detect the F arm where the weak interaction introduces a complex phase violating charge parity.
Sustain the paradice of the physical neutral meson as an unresolved superposition of even and odd parity.
Recombine the particle and antiparticle branches via destructive and constructive interference.
Compose the discrete charge conjugation and parity transformations into the unified operator.
Confirm the Lagrangian density recognizes its own invariance under the applied symmetry operations.
Permanently record the CKM matrix phases as the irreversible source of symmetry breaking.
